accountUid.description: Uid of the account the capability is delegated to.

role.description: Role the capability grants to the delegate.

capabilityId.description: Optional capability id supplied separately from `id`; the collaborators listing leaves it unset.

grantId.description: The account and path the capability grants access to.

label.description: Short, user-provided label identifying the capability.

description: A capability as the API returns it: which account was granted which role on which grant id.
